Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.password

Class JdbcUserAccountRepository

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.password.JdbcUserAccountRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserAccountRepository
@Repository public class JdbcUserAccountRepository extends Object implements UserAccountRepository
UserAccountRepository reading user accounts from the users, user_authorities and user_passwords tables.
